name: Gangtok (Sikkim)
summary: Sikkim's tidy hill capital with views of Kanchenjunga, monasteries, MG Marg and day trips to Tsomgo Lake and Nathula.
season_note: March to May has rhododendrons and clear weather; October-November is crisp with good views. Winter is cold and snowy; monsoon causes landslides.
avoid_note: Landslides can shut north Sikkim routes in the monsoon; Nathula may close in bad weather.
entry_note: Indian visa required; Sikkim restricted areas (Nathula, Tsomgo, Yumthang) need a permit arranged through a local operator. Check the latest rules with the embassy before booking.

reach.how: Dhaka to Bagdogra (Siliguri) (Biman, US-Bangla, IndiGo, Air India)
reach.note: About 5 hours by shared jeep to Gangtok.

reach.how: Dhaka to Siliguri by road, then shared jeep Siliguri to Gangtok
reach.note: Check Bangladesh-India land-border rules for Siliguri.

reach.how: Kolkata to New Jalpaiguri then jeep

local.note: Required for permit routes like Tsomgo/Nathula.

attractions.name: MG Marg
attractions.what: A pedestrian-only promenade with cafes and shops.
attractions.tip: Visit in the evening; no vehicles or smoking.

attractions.name: Tsomgo (Changu) Lake
attractions.what: A high-altitude glacial lake at 3,780m, often frozen in winter.
attractions.tip: Permit via a local operator; altitude can affect you.

attractions.name: Nathula Pass
attractions.what: A mountain pass on the border; visits are allowed some days with permit.
attractions.tip: Closed some days; carry passport and permit.

attractions.name: Rumtek Monastery
attractions.what: One of the biggest and most important monasteries in Sikkim.
attractions.tip: Dress modestly; no photos inside the main hall.

attractions.name: Enchey Monastery
attractions.what: A small, peaceful 200-year-old monastery above the town.

attractions.name: Gangtok Ropeway and Ganesh Tok
attractions.what: A cable car ride with views of the town and mountains.

attractions.name: Hanuman Tok and Tashi View Point
attractions.what: A hilltop temple and a viewpoint for Kanchenjunga.

attractions.name: Banjhakri Falls Energy Park
attractions.what: A landscaped park with waterfall, shamans and walkways.

rules: Alcohol is legal but drinking in public is frowned upon.
Smoking and spitting banned in public areas.
Permit rules: carry passport and permits.
